decisions.reason: This decorative carpet still fits the firm's accessories and project-interior offering, but after another year the risk of assortment streamlining among similar rugs has increased somewhat.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet reinforces the brand's craftsmanship and premium-material positioning, so management would usually retain it despite its more specialized demand.
The product remains easy to place in residential and contract interior concepts, yet its similarity to other recently launched low-pile carpets gives it a relatively higher rationalization risk.
The corner bench extends the firm's established furniture portfolio for living, hospitality and project settings, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
This carpet suits the firm's broad interior accessories range, but it is one of several close rug introductions and therefore faces the strongest chance of being cut if the collection is simplified.
The swivel shell chair line matches the firm's focus on flexible contemporary living and working environments and is therefore unlikely to be discontinued quickly.
